description: Free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows & Linux to write, ask, check and compare across your own documents. Fact-check a draft or report against PDFs, Word, Excel & PowerPoint, with every answer citing the exact page. Compare hundreds of contracts in one table. Meeting transcription. Works with ChatGPT, Claude or your API key.
summary: IncarnaMind is a free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux where you ask questions about your own documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and more) and write with AI. Every answer cites the exact page, and IncarnaMind checks that each quoted passage is really there.
